methods.executive_summary: STA-Net-PyTorch 已完成 7 任务、strict 与 sample-random 两条五折协议共 70/70 个正式 job；70 个训练均通过至少 40 epoch + 30 个无改进 validation 的收敛规则，70 个评估摘要和 8 个 aggregate 工件均在位，25 个方法测试全部通过。输入/输出适配覆盖 EEG+HbO/HbR、16×16 空间投影、valid-mask、六分类与 REFED mask-aware sequence regression。由于 EEG 3 s + fNIRS 13 s（DSR 2+13 s）是 method-native context，和当前 support-matched EFRM 8/8 s（DSR 2/2 s）不一致，结果必须标为 method_native_context_reference，不能直接进入 support-matched 总表；不得重跑、重选或重新开放 protected 结果。

input_contract.validity_policy: valid_mask_only; legacy analysis_valid_mask/artifact mask has no invalidity authority
input_contract.bad_channel_policy: omit independently bad channels before interpolation; no copy/mirror/random fill
input_contract.coordinate_policy: official STA-Net grid on matching inventory, otherwise normalized unified geometry with provenance

output_contract.classification_primary_metric: outer-fold macro-F1 mean and sample SD
output_contract.regression_primary_metric: outer-fold native-coordinate masked CCC mean and sample SD
